title: Seleção 2027/1 - Mestrado em Computação (PPGC)
institution: Universidade Federal do Rio Grande do Sul (UFRGS), Programa de Pós-Graduação em Computação (PPGC)
about: UFRGS Graduate Program in Computing (PPGC) master's selection for 2027/1 under Edital PPGC 008/2026. Applications run 19 October to 18 November 2026 through the online system; at least 30% of places are reserved for historically discriminated groups.
requirements: Applications only via the programme online system
At least 30% of places for historically and socially discriminated groups

upskill.name: AI Foundations Academy page
why: No course reached a genuine match: the record's only stated subject requirement is "Computer science", and its qualifications ("Edital PPGC 008/2026", "Applications only via the programme online system") are procedural, not skills.

Shortlist scores came from the word stem "comput" alone (e.g. A001.23 "Affective computing: emotion recognition, sentiment-aware systems"), which does not cover a general computing master's admission.
Fallback: field "Computer science" → AI Foundations Academy, the catalog's core computing/ML track (e.g. A001.01 "Machine Learning - Foundations & Methods I").
